source.original_question:
Which two of the following expressions are OPPOSITE of $\tan (\theta)$ ?
Choose 2 answers:
Choices:
A:$\tan (\pi+\theta)$
B:$\tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$
C:$\tan (2 \pi-\theta)$
D:$\tan (\pi-\theta)$

adaptations.reason: Two-answer source C,D converted to equivalent single-choice pair C under four-enum schema.
Radius changed from 1 to 6; angular identities and quadrant unchanged.

independent_solution.method: tan(2π-θ)=-tanθ and tan(π-θ)=-tanθ. tan(π+θ)=tanθ and tan(π/2-θ)=cotθ.
